selection_note: Twenty assistant-selected mathematics topics, excluding the three prior discovery-writer calibration topics. These are development coverage cases, not a random sample or preregistered holdout. Grades and recently taught skills are stipulated learner specifications, not observed student knowledge.

cases.target_concept: Equivalent fractions as the same proportion despite different partitions. Students have not yet learned a formal equivalence rule.
teacher_recently_taught: Fractions as parts of equal wholes

cases.target_concept: A common unit for adding fractions with different denominators. Students have not yet learned the common-denominator algorithm.
teacher_recently_taught: Fractions as parts of a whole
Adding fractions with the same denominator

cases.target_concept: Division by a fraction as measuring how many fractional units fit. Students have not yet learned invert-and-multiply.

cases.topic: sharing a total in a ratio
cases.target_concept: Part-to-part versus part-to-whole ratios when sharing a total. Students have not yet learned the ratio-sharing algorithm.
Percentage changes depend on their reference quantity; equal increases and decreases do not generally cancel.
teacher_recently_taught: Finding a percentage of a quantity

cases.target_concept: Distinguishing a proportional relationship from an additive or fixed-charge relationship. Students have not yet learned the constant-of-proportionality criterion.
A common solution satisfying two linear conditions. Students have not yet learned elimination or substitution for systems.
Representing a set of feasible choices with linear inequalities rather than finding a single equality solution.
Rate of change versus starting amount in a linear relationship. Students have not yet learned a formal slope formula.
Representing a growing quadratic pattern and distinguishing it from linear growth. Students have not yet learned quadratic pattern formulas.
Area and perimeter can vary independently; fixed perimeter need not imply fixed area.

cases.topic: length and area scaling in similar shapes
cases.target_concept: Area scales differently from length under uniform enlargement. Students have not yet learned the squared-scale-factor rule.
Relating the side lengths of a right triangle using squares. Students have not yet learned the Pythagorean theorem.
Constructing a defensible method for circle area. Students have not yet learned the area formula.

cases.topic: volume and surface area of rectangular boxes
cases.target_concept: Equal-volume boxes can require different surface material. Students have not yet learned a surface-area optimization method.
Constructing a complete equally likely sample space rather than treating named outcomes as equally likely. Students have not yet learned compound-event probability methods.
Updating probability by restricting the relevant population. Students have not yet learned a conditional-probability formula.
A larger sample can still be systematically unrepresentative. Students have not yet learned formal sampling-bias analysis.
A combined mean must account for group sizes. Students have not yet learned the weighted-mean formula.
An association can have competing causal explanations. Students have not yet learned formal causal inference.

shared_context.subject: mathematics
shared_context.task_rule: Generate a new exercise for exploration before instruction on its target, not a worked example or a lesson. Do not reuse the earlier consistency, average-speed or fair-division calibration tasks.
shared_context.prior_knowledge_boundary: The teacher_recently_taught list stipulates the recent learner repertoire. Grounded D1 may unpack these resources, but must not assume instruction in the target method. This is a hypothetical learner specification, not a measured student profile.
shared_context.provenance_rule: Use clearly fictional task data where needed; do not claim invented survey or experimental records are actual observations.
